name: Fathom
summary: Fathom is built for accounting firms and advisors who report on many client companies. Pro costs $450 a month for 25 companies, and a Portfolio plan covers 100 companies for $67 a month, with forecasting, budgets, scenarios and variance reporting on Pro. Billing is monthly with no minimum term.

facts.text: Pro includes three-way cash flow forecasting, scenario planning, rolling and driver-based forecasts, budgets and what-ifs, and variance reporting.
The Portfolio plan does not include forecasting or budget tools; a company must be upgraded to Pro for three-way cash flow, custom reporting and consolidations.
Fathom lists Xero, QuickBooks Online and Desktop, MYOB and FreeAgent integrations, plus Excel and Google Sheets import.
Prices are listed in USD, AUD, NZD, CAD, GBP, EUR and ZAR and exclude sales tax.

plans.name: Pro (Gold)
plans.notes: Extra companies cost $17 each beyond the 25 included. Unlimited users are not stated for Pro on the page

plans.name: Portfolio
plans.notes: Unlimited users and 36 months of history per company. Tiers of 300 and unlimited companies are listed without prices

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For firms with more than 50 companies; includes the Pro feature set and volume pricing

hiddenCosts: Forecasting, budgets and variance reporting need Pro, so a Portfolio company that needs them costs more than the $0.67 per company headline.
Upgrades happen automatically as companies are added, but downgrades do not, so a firm has to change its own plan after removing companies.

contract.cancellation: Billing is monthly with no minimum term, and cancelling stops renewal at the end of the current monthly billing cycle.
